ops.en: THE BRIEFING PERFORMED. va-YAGED le-faro — the governor delivers the audience he scripted at 46:31 ('I will go up and TELL Pharaoh'): the tell-verb lands within two verses of its rehearsal; ve-hinam be- eretz GOSHEN — the family parked at the district the script aims to win: the machine notes the stage set before the king speaks.

THE FIVE [G70-13]. u-mi-QETZE echav — 'from the EDGE of his brothers' he took FIVE: the Kitzur's letter-count reads the edge- word as 'these are the WEAK ones' (the five who could not be shown off as soldiers, lest Pharaoh draft them) — carried named; the governor curates even his family's face.

THE PARTITION IS EXACT ACROSS ALL ELEVEN BROTHERS [claim G70-21, machine-checked]. The five taken 'from the EDGE' are read as the WEAK, deliberately shown so that Pharaoh would not conscript the strong - and the test for strength is read backwards out of Moses' blessing: whoever's name is REPEATED there was mighty. Machine-checked prefix-tolerantly, with the homograph separated by morphology: exac…

THE PERFORMANCE [G70-01 MARQUEE; G70-02]. ma maasekhem — the king asks the question VERBATIM as Joseph predicted it (46:33); the answer performs 46:34's scripted va-amartem ('you shall say') — gen_69's open say-demand settles HERE (carried as a corpus settlement link: the one-world law, no in-unit RESULT for another unit's queue). And the letter marks the delivery TWICE: ROE tzon avadekha — 'your …

THE PETITION. la-GUR ba-aretz banu — 'to SOJOURN in the land we have come': the sojourn-word declares the stay temporary at the very gate of the four-hundred-year descent (the machine files the irony without ruling on it); yeshvu-NA avadekha be-eretz GOSHEN — the pray-word (na) makes it a petition, not a plan: the demand pushed before the king, awaiting the king's own mouth.

THE PATTERN'S THIRD SEAT IN THIS SWEEP ALONE [claim G70-29]. The sojourning verb here matches the first patriarch's own, and the standing table of matched ink-pairs counts it. Onkelos writes the sense in - to dwell TEMPORARILY - so the pairing the chain reads is the reading the buffer states. [folded shape: kept record]

THE TURN. avikha ve-achekha BAU ELEKHA — 'have come TO YOU': the king answers the brothers by addressing the brother — the grant will pass through Joseph's hand, as the whole span's bread does; the machine notes the court's chain of command.

THE GRANT [G70-11; G70-13]. YESHVU be-eretz GOSHEN — the king answers the petition in its own words (yeshvu for yeshvu-na, Goshen for Goshen): the demand pops two verses after its push; be-METAV ha- aretz HOSHEV — 'in the BEST of the land SETTLE them': the settle- imperative with the shin in tsere [VERIFIED under G70-11], and the Kitzur's count reads best-of-the-land = GOSHEN by the letters' own a…

THE BLESSING GIVEN [G70-06]. va-YAAMIDEHU lifne faro — 'and he STOOD HIM before Pharaoh': the stand-verb written LEAN, exactly TWICE in the Torah — Jacob supported before the king, Joshua supported before Eleazar (Num 27:22) — the Kitzur: neither standing was complete, and the letter thins both [VERIFIED: manifest G70-06]; va-YEVAREKH yaaqov et paro — the landless shepherd BLESSES the throne of Eg…

THE QUESTION. ka-MA yeme shene chayekha — the king who asked the brothers their WORK asks the father his DAYS: the court reads Jacob's face as a number; the machine files the question the answer will bend.

THE ANSWER [G70-11]. yeme shene MEGURAI — Jacob answers 'life' with 'SOJOURNINGS' (the gimel soft in megurehem at the verse's close, asserted under G70-11): the father corrects the king's noun — he has not LIVED here, he has lodged; meat ve-RAIM — 'few and evil': the Kitzur's pattern-file (ve-yehi yeme — whoever is given the days- formula did not reach his fathers' days: Enoch, Lamech, named [G70-…

THE PAIR SEALED. va-YEVAREKH yaaqov et paro — the bless-verb doubled around the audience (47:7 and here): entry-blessing and exit- blessing bracket the interview — the readings give the exit-blessing content (that the Nile rise to his feet); the machine marks the event: the audience opened and closed by the patriarch's mouth, not the king's.

THE HOLDING [G70-03]. va-YOSHEV yosef — the settle-verb performs the king's hoshev (47:6); ACHUZA — a HOLDING: stronger than the sojourn they asked (la-gur, 47:4) — the machine notes the upgrade the text does not comment on; be-eretz RAMSES — the ayin SILENT (sheva): MS against Ibn Ezra — THIS Rameses, the dwelling, is not the store-city of the bondage (Exod 1:11, ayin OPEN with patach), and the s…

A PUNISHMENT RECORDED AS COMMUTED, AND THE COMMUTATION IS THIS BLOCK'S EVENT [claim G70-29]. The standing decree held that he was liable to be brought down to Egypt IN CHAINS and was instead drawn down by his son's hand. Here the softened form executes in full: settlement in the best of the land, by royal grant. The machine carries the decree from its own block and discharges it at this verse. [fo…

THE SUSTAINING. va-YEKHALKEL — the sustain-verb (45:11's promise 've-khilkalti otkha there' now performed — the machine notes the promise-keeping without a queue: covenant speech, receipted in narrative); lechem LEFI ha-taf — 'by the MOUTH of the little ones': bread measured to the smallest eater — the readings hear tenderness in the clause; the Kitzur's seventeen-for-seventeen (the son returns th…

THE LANGUISHING. va-TELAH — the languish-verb (its rare stem: the land itself goes faint); eretz mitzrayim VE-ERETZ kenaan — both lands in one exhaustion: the famine the dreams decreed (41:30's 'the famine shall consume the land') now eats the sentence's own geography; the machine files the narrative floor under the four transactions ahead.

THE SILVER [G70-05]. va-yelaqet... et KOL ha-kesef — transaction ONE of the four: ALL the silver of two lands gleaned for grain; BETA faro — 'into the HOUSE of Pharaoh': the phrase's Torah-pair is the swarm entering 'the house of Pharaoh' FIRST (Exod 8:20) — the Kitzur's measure-for-measure: the king who will forget the silver- bringer receives the plague by the same door [VERIFIED: manifest G70-0…

THE CRY. va-YITOM ha-kesef — the silver COMPLETES (the tam-verb: spent to its end); HAVA lanu LECHEM — 'GIVE us bread': all Egypt pushes the demand the brothers once carried (43:2's shivru-lanu inverted: now the empire begs at the Hebrew's door); ve-lama NAMUT negdekha — 'why should we DIE before you': the die-word that will anchor the next demand too — the queue holds an empire's hunger.

THE EXCHANGE OFFERED. HAVU miqnekhem — the governor answers the give-word (hava) with the same stem: give-for-give — bread priced in herds; im AFES kasef — 'if the silver is NOTHING' (the efes-word: the zero the ledger just wrote): transaction TWO opens on the herds the family was hired to keep (47:6).

THE CARRYING [the pop]. va-yiten lahem yosef LECHEM — bread given: the empire's demand (47:15) discharges in the herd-currency; va- yeNAHALEM ba-lechem — 'and he CARRIED them with bread': the shepherd's lead-gently verb (the one Jacob used for the nursing flocks, 33:14) — the machine notes the trade's grammar: the abomination-trade's own verb now feeds Egypt; ba-shana HA-HI — the first of the two …

THE LAST TWO ITEMS [G70-12]. lo NEKHACHED me-adoni — 'we will not HIDE from my lord' (the hide-verb of confession); bilti im GEVIYATENU ve-ADMATENU — 'nothing but our BODY and our GROUND': the gimel of the body-word DAGESHED [VERIFIED under G70-12], the ground- word opening the file the academies split over (G70-04, at the next verse): the empire inventories itself down to skin and soil.

THE SELF-SALE [G70-04]. QENE otanu ve-et ADMATENU ba-lachem — 'BUY us and our ground for bread': the empire petitions for its own purchase — the demand pushed with two clauses (the buying and the seed); ve-TEN zera — 'GIVE seed' (the tav in segol, asserted under G70-12): the future's demand inside the present's; and the verse's own key word carries the ACADEMIES' SPLIT — ADMATENU three times: Sura…

THE PURCHASE. va-YIQEN yosef et KOL admat mitzrayim — transaction THREE: the whole ground of Egypt passes in one verse; ish SADEHU — 'every man his FIELD': the singular distributes the sale to each seller (the machine notes the letter's arithmetic of totality: all = each); va-tehi ha-aretz LE-FARO — the land's new genitive.

THE TRANSFER. ve-et ha-am HEEVIR oto le-ARIM — the people PASSED OVER into the cities, border to border: the readings' account (Rashi's — so the brothers would not be called exiles in a land of the uprooted) is named; the machine files the verse as administration, not judgment: the mover was moved once too.

THE POLICY'S SHAPE IS SETTLED IN TRANSLATION [claim G70-26]. 'He moved the people TO THE CITIES' becomes 'he transferred them FROM CITY TO CITY' - a rotation, not an urbanization. This is the chapter's standing crux, where the ancient versions part company, and the received translation votes for population transfer. It decides what the unit's resettlement operator models, so it is carried explicit…

THE EXEMPTION. RAQ admat ha-KOHANIM lo qana — 'ONLY the priests' ground he did not buy': the restrictive raq carves the single hole in the total sale; ki CHOQ la-kohanim — a STATUTE-portion from Pharaoh (the choq-word twice in the verse): the machine notes the precedent — a standing allotment defeats even a famine-sale; the statute Joseph will write at 47:26 borrows this verse's own word.

THE SEED [G70-07]. hen QANITI etkhem ha-YOM — 'I have BOUGHT you this day': the self-sale demand's first clause receipted in the perfect tense; HE lakhem ZERA — 'BEHOLD, seed for you': the second clause (ten zera) granted with the behold-word — the pop lands on the Torah's ONE token of the Aramaic-flavored he ('behold'), and the Kitzur's Masorah-three spans Scripture: behold-SEED here, behold- YOU…

THE TERMS [G70-12]. u-netatem CHAMISHIT le-faro — 'you shall give a FIFTH to Pharaoh': the rate the dreams' economy fixed (41:34's chimesh-verb in the counsel) becomes the empire's rent; ve-ARBA ha- yadot — 'and FOUR HANDS shall be yours': the letter counts the people's share double-double the crown's; ve-LA-ASHER be-vatekhem — the alef in chataf patach (asserted under G70-12): even the dependents…

THE RECEIPT. HECHEYITANU — 'you have KEPT US ALIVE': one word answers the whole file of die-words (namut at 47:15, 47:19) — the empire's receipt for its own survival; ve-hayinu AVADIM le-faro — the servant-clause accepted willingly: the machine notes the exchange's close — bread for silver, herds, ground, and body, and the payers say thank you.

THE STATUTE [G70-09]. va-YASEM ota yosef LE-CHOQ — the machine installs the standing rule: ad ha-yom ha-ZE — 'to THIS DAY' (the narrator's own clock reaches past the story); le-faro la-CHOMESH — the fifth as law, the exemption (raq admat ha-kohanim) written into the statute's own text from 47:22; and the set-verb carries the chapter's mark-question: MS reads va-yasem WITH THE GALGAL (the rolling s…

THE FAMINE ECONOMY ENDS IN A STATUTE THAT OUTLIVES THE STORY [claim G70-25]. The fifth belongs to the crown, and Onkelos renders it as a STANDING OBLIGATION they must give, keeping the priests' exemption word for word. The text reports the law as still in force, which makes this the one act in the block that survives as law rather than as event. The grain program read at the previous group reaches…

THE INCREASE. va-yeshev YISRAEL — the dwell-verb lands on the name Israel (the grant of 47:6 lived-in); va-YEACHAZU vah — they TOOK HOLDING (the achuza of 47:11 conjugated into a life); va-YIFRU va- YIRBU meod — the be-fruitful-and-multiply pair (1:28's blessing- verbs; 35:11's promise to this very man) narrated DONE on the seventy: the machine notes the covenant arithmetic beginning — the next bo…

THE SEALED YEARS [G70-10]. VA-YECHI yaaqov — 'and Jacob LIVED': and before this word the scroll leaves NO GAP — not a closed break, not an open one: the SEALED PORTION (MS from a manuscript Bible: the seder marked, the text unbroken — 'as the sages expounded': the eyes of Israel closed by the exile beginning here) — carried named-only by design: layout lives on the scroll's spacing, not the stream…

A RULE ABOUT A VERB, PROVED BY THIS VERSE'S OWN NUMBER [claim G70-22, machine-checked]. Whoever has 'APPROACHED' written of him did not reach his fathers' years. Machine-checked on the Torah members: 147 here, against 175 and 180 - short of both; and 120 against 137 in the other family - short again. Two independent families confirmed in our own ink. THE THIRD LEG IS DECLARED UNOPENED, lying in a …

THE VERDICT SPLITS BY TEXT LAYER, AND ONLY ONE HALF IS A VERDICT [claim G70-23]. The chain asks why this portion is CLOSED - the only weekly portion with no open space before it - and gives three answers: the enslavement beginning and their eyes closing, the end of days sealed from him, and his being shielded from the world's troubles. IN THIS CORPUS THE MACHINE IS SILENT: we carry cantillation on…

THE BAN [G70-08; G70-13]. va-YIQRVU yeme yisrael la-MUT — 'and the days of Israel DREW NEAR to die': the death-approach formula's one Torah adjacency [VERIFIED: manifest G70-08] — its Scripture-partner is DAVID's (1 Kgs 2:1, named): one hundred forty-seven psalms answering one hundred forty-seven years, each father crowned his son alive; SIM na yadkha TACHAT yerekhi — the thigh-oath gesture: Abrah…

AUTHORITY EBBING, CENSUSED IN THREE CASES [claim G70-24]. Against 'there is no dominion on the day of death': trumpets sequestered so another could not sound them; a subordinate acting before his master; and a king demoted in the writing itself, the title dropped as the dominion goes. So here the patriarch lowers himself before his own child. THE THIRD CASE'S INK IS OUTSIDE THIS CORPUS and is carr…

THE CHARGE [G70-12]. ve-SHAKHAVTI im avotai — 'I will LIE with my fathers': the lying-formula claims the cave before naming it (49:29 will name it); u-nesatani mi-mitzrayim u-QEVARTANI bi-qvuratam — 'CARRY me from Egypt and BURY me in their burying-place': the positive charge pushed beside the ban — the queue holds the death before the death; anokhi EESE khi-devarekha — 'I will DO according to you…

THE OATH THE LAST UNITS OF THE BOOK WILL EXECUTE [claim G70-28]. Four reasons stand on the record against burial in Egypt - the dust destined to become lice; the fear of being made an object of worship, carrying the rule that punishment reaches the worshipped as the worshipper; the refusal to let Egypt earn merit; and the land doctrine, whose dead rise first and for whose sake the Holy One bores t…

THE OATH ASKED. HISHAVA li — 'SWEAR to me': the father converts the acceptance (47:30) into covenant-grade security — the word alone did not suffice where a grave is at stake (the machine notes the escalation: word, then oath; 50:5-6 will trade on exactly this oath before Pharaoh).

SWORN IN PLACE [G70-13]. va-YISHAVA lo — 'and he SWORE to him': the demand discharges inside its own verse (the same-verse class); va- YISHTACHU yisrael al ROSH ha-mita — 'and Israel BOWED on the head of the BED': the Kitzur's count reads the bow as thanks for good news, and his bed-file arms — the righteous STRENGTHEN on the bed (48:2, next span) where Haman FALLS on it (Esth 7:8, named) [G70-13]…

A DELIBERATE NON-MOVE, RECORDED BECAUSE THE ALTERNATIVE IS THE FAMOUS ONE [claim G70-27]. The same consonants permit reading the bed as a STAFF, and the buffer declines it, keeping the bed and so fixing the gesture as made from the sickbed. This corpus records translations that move; this row records one that conspicuously does not, where a move was available and widely taken. [folded shape: dual-…
